skills.name: release-notes
skills.when: Use when drafting release notes or a changelog entry for a new version

skills.name: dbt-model-review
skills.when: Use when reviewing a dbt model change for grain, tests and lineage impact

skills.name: incident-postmortem
skills.when: Use when writing a blameless postmortem after an outage or failed deploy

skills.name: api-endpoint
skills.when: Use when adding or changing an HTTP endpoint, its request schema and handler

skills.name: schema-migration
skills.when: Use when planning a database schema migration with a rollback path

skills.name: test-plan
skills.when: Use when designing a test plan or deciding which tests a change needs

skills.name: dependency-upgrade
skills.when: Use when upgrading a library version and checking for breaking changes

skills.name: performance-profiling
skills.when: Use when a slow request or batch job needs profiling to find the bottleneck

skills.name: security-review
skills.when: Use when reviewing a change for injection, leaked secrets or authorization flaws

skills.name: contributor-guide
skills.when: Use when writing or updating a getting-started guide for new contributors

skills.name: flag-rollout
skills.when: Use when planning a staged rollout behind a feature flag with a kill switch

skills.name: data-backfill
skills.when: Use when planning a historical data backfill for an existing table

cases.prompt: Draft the changelog entry for version 2.4 of the CLI.
Write up what shipped in this version for users reading the update page.
Summarize the new features and fixes going out in Friday's release.
Review the dbt change to the orders model before I merge it.
Check whether my edit to the revenue model changes its grain or breaks its tests.
Write the postmortem for yesterday's checkout outage.
We had a two-hour payments incident; help me document what went wrong without blaming anyone.
Add a new endpoint that returns an invoice as a PDF.
Expose the export job status over HTTP so the dashboard can poll it.
Plan the schema migration that splits the users table in two.
We need to rename a column in Postgres safely and be able to undo it.
Design a test plan for the new retry logic.
Which cases should I cover before shipping the rate limiter?
Upgrade the requests library to its latest major version.
Bump pydantic from v1 to v2 and find what breaks.
Profile the nightly import job; it got three times slower.
Find the performance bottleneck in the search endpoint.
Do a security review of the new file upload handler.
Check this login change for SQL injection or leaked tokens.
Update the getting-started guide for new contributors.
Explain to a first-week engineer how to run the project locally, as a doc in the repo.
Roll out the new pricing page to ten percent of users first, behind a flag.
Plan a staged release of dark mode with a way to turn it off instantly.
Backfill the last two years of order history into the new table.
Recompute daily revenue for every day since 2023 in the summary table.
Draft release notes for the 3.0 launch.
Write a blameless review of the failed deploy on Monday.
Review the dbt lineage impact of dropping the legacy customers source.
Add request validation to the create-user API.
Help me decide which tests the payment refactor needs.
Explain how Python's GIL affects threads.
Write a regular expression that matches ISO dates.
Rename the variable tmp to buffer in this function.
What is the difference between a list and a tuple?
Translate this error message into plain English.
Release the file lock before returning from the function.
Add a docstring to the parse_row helper.
Why does my for loop skip the last element?
Format this JSON so it is easier to read.
Flag any typos in this paragraph.
